summary.description: Isoproturon is a colourless crystalline herbicide, highly soluble in water and organic solvents, that inhibits photosynthesis.
emission_sources: Use as a pre- and post-emergence pesticide/herbicide in agriculture
environmental_impact: Toxic to aquatic organisms and dangerous to the environment
Can persist in water bodies but is broken down easily by soil microorganisms
Background exposure levels are not considered harmful to human health

top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: Isoproturon is very toxic to aquatic organisms and can persist in water bodies, threatening aquatic ecosystems.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: The pollutant's presence in water bodies can degrade water quality and pose risks to clean water resources.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Use of isoproturon as a pesticide raises concerns about sustainable agricultural practices and environmental safety.
